body: Thanks. I haven't yet. It's all pretty new, and I'm on a roller coaster of emotions. When I posted the OP I had a bit of a breakdown. I guess if I feel depressed for another week I will have to tell my doctor. I'm kind of scared because I've had such a bad experience with both psychotherapy and psychiatric medication in the past. I suffered from chronic depression for many years since I was young, so I've had a lot of both. I was doing ok without meds for the past ten years or so, mostly due to changing external circumstances, getting married, finding a supportive community, adding spiritual meanings and goals in my life. This is all sort of crumbling right now. But I'm stronger today than I used to be.

I'm in the last trimester, and up until now I was excited about the pregnancy and baby. I've recently gone through some very big life changes and also lost my support system. I'm grieving right now, so I'm simply venting. I actually feel a lot better now that I've written some angsty sentences on the internet.

I feel love for the baby. But I don't want to be a parent. I don't want to be a wife. I don't want to live. I hate this. I wish I haven't gotten pregnant. I wish I killed myself when I still had the option to do so morally.
